objective: Test whether the direct Nikkei-futures first/last-30-minute path pattern remains visible in a later 2026 Japan 225 public proxy sample when SPY is used as an explicit proxy for the prior completed S&P 500 cash-market return.
direct_evidence: Iwanaga (2026), How the prior day's S&P 500 returns influence the intraday returns of Nikkei 225 futures, DOI 10.1016/j.finr.2026.100108

relationship_to_prior_families.true_family: INTRADAY_PATH_US_TO_JNU_G1 remains frozen and requires true OSE/JNU minute data plus the exact preregistered predictor class.
relationship_to_prior_families.prior_proxy: INTRADAY_PATH_US_NIKKEI_PROXY_G0 was negative on 2011-2018 proxy data.
relationship_to_prior_families.g2_rule: This 2026 later-period holdout is a distinct proxy stress family; it cannot erase or rescue G0 and has no true-JNU promotion power.

target.instrument: Japan 225 index/CFD-style proxy, not OSE futures

predictor.role: Explicit proxy for prior completed S&P 500 cash-market return

targets.FIRST_30M: Japan-proxy return from first available minute at/after 09:00 JST to 09:30 JST boundary, without tuning
targets.LAST_30M: Japan-proxy return from 14:30 JST boundary to final available minute before 15:00 JST, without tuning

causal_predictor: Most recent completed SPY U.S. trading-day close-to-close return strictly before the Japanese target session opens.
cell_pass_requires: Expected coefficient sign in the expanding estimates at the end of OOS
Full-OOS MSE improvement vs expanding intercept-only baseline > 0
Sign accuracy is not worse than baseline

family_interpretation.PROXY_PATH_CURRENT_SAMPLE_CONSISTENT: Both H1 and H2 meet cell gates and their one-sided bootstrap p-values (1-P) pass Holm alpha 0.10.

forbidden: Replace SPY with QQQ/NQ after seeing outcomes
Add technical indicators or regimes to rescue failure
Delete either H1 or H2 after results
Call a positive result true-JNU PASS
Use proxy result as live directional probability without the frozen true-OSE family
